nodes.description: Mapping of address to token balance; mutated in transfer and transferFrom and initialized in constructor.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount; written in approve and read (never decremented) in transferFrom.
Fixed total token supply, 10000000 * 10 ** 18, assigned to the deployer at construction.
Public token name string 'NugzCoin'.
Public token symbol string 'NUGZ'.
Public decimals value, 18.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, authorization checks and allowance bookkeeping.
Constructor that mints the entire totalSupply to msg.sender.
Public view-like function returning balances[owner]; used as an internal check helper.
Transfers value from msg.sender to 'to' after a balance check, then mutates balances.
Transfers value from 'from' to 'to' using allowance; allowance is never decremented, allowing repeated spending.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value without any sanity checks.
State mutation block in transfer: balances[to] += value and balances[msg.sender] -= value executed after the require checks.
State mutation block in transferFrom: balances[to] += value and balances[from] -= value with no decrement of allowance.
Unrestricted write of allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value, enabling allowance front-running / overwrite.
Initial privileged state write balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply performed in the constructor.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer, used in balance arithmetic and the require check.
Address parameter of balanceOf used to index the balances mapping.
Source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are checked.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, compared against allowance and used in arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.

edges.reason: Constructor mints the full totalSupply to the untrusted msg.sender, granting privileged initial ownership.
Constructor executes the initial balance minting operation.
balanceOf is invoked with msg.sender as the owner argument inside transfer.
transfer calls the balanceOf helper to enforce the balance requirement.
transfer debits the balance of msg.sender, so the caller's identity controls value movement.
The value parameter feeds the require comparison and the balance addition/subtraction in transfer.
The destination parameter influences the state write location balances[to] in transfer.
transfer executes the balance mutation block after its checks.
The transfer mutation block writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom consumes allowance[from][msg.sender], so the caller identity authorizes the spend.
The from parameter determines whose balance and allowance are debited in transferFrom.
The to parameter determines the credit target balances[to] in transferFrom.
The value parameter is used in the allowance require and in the balance arithmetic of transferFrom.
transferFrom reads allowance[from][msg.sender] but never decrements it, so the same allowance can be spent repeatedly.
transferFrom executes the balance mutation block without updating allowance.
The transferFrom mutation block writes the balances mapping.
approve grants an allowance keyed by msg.sender, so the caller controls which funds can be pulled.
The spender parameter selects the allowance mapping key written by approve.
The value parameter is stored directly as the allowance amount in approve.
approve performs the allowance write operation.
The approve operation writes the allowance mapping.
The owner parameter indexes the balances mapping returned by balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: Local parameter node only meaningful as the destination argument of transfer; merge into the transfer function node.
Value parameter used solely in transfer's require check and balance arithmetic; absorb into transfer.
Owner parameter exists only to index balances inside balanceOf; merge into balanceOf.
From parameter is only consumed by the transferFrom allowance and balance logic; merge into transferFrom.
To parameter is only consumed by the transferFrom credit write; merge into transferFrom.
Value parameter is only consumed by transferFrom checks and arithmetic; merge into transferFrom.
Spender parameter is only used as the allowance key inside approve; merge into approve.
Value parameter is only written as the allowance amount inside approve; merge into approve.
